I wanted to leave right then and there but he begged me to give him a second chance. Since then we've gone through therapy but there are still a lot of things he refuses to change. I'm tired of going to therapy and waiting on him to recognize whats right and wrong. I feel myself checking out of the marriage but the one thing pulling me back is my grad school enrollment. ​ I started a prestigious grad program last fall and I have one more year to go before graduating. They said he's been a total ass to me so this is a small bit of retribution, and that I deserve to get my degree at the very least. WIBTA if I actually did this?
